NextAction.description: What the caller should do next. Closed set; agents branch on it.

oneOf.description: No app carries client credentials; register one.
The target app has credentials and no token; sign in.
Another app is the one to use; rerun naming it.
The store could not be read or parsed; look at the file.
X refused the app; enroll it in the developer portal.
The word named no command; read the help of the nearest one.

NextStep.description:
The `next_step` object carried by an error envelope.

Exactly one of [`Self::command`] and [`Self::template`] is present,
except for [`NextAction::EnrollApp`], which carries only `docs`:
a command is a verbatim invocation safe for a non-TTY caller, while a
template carries angle-bracket placeholders the caller must fill in.

command.description: A runnable invocation, when one exists.

docs.description: Documentation URL, when a recipe exists.

template.description: A placeholder invocation, when the caller must supply values.

description: The three envelope variants — one per `status` discriminator value.

oneOf.description:
Success envelope. `payload` holds verb-specific fields; agents
merge them flat at the top level for legibility.

exit_code.description: Exit code the verb would have returned on actual execution.

would_succeed.description: True iff every precondition checked clean.

oneOf.description:
Error envelope. Every field the runtime emits is declared on
[`ErrorBody`], so an undeclared key cannot reach a caller. Boxed
because that body is much larger than the other two variants.

action.description: Skill verb the envelope reports on.

available_in_app.description: Auth schemes available for the active app.

bearer.description: Whether `auth clear` targeted the bearer token.

exit_code.description:
Structured exit code per the sysexits-inspired matrix in
`xurl::error`.

host.description: Agent host a skill verb targeted.

install_dir.description: Directory a skill verb would install into.

message.description: Human-readable message. Omitted entirely (not `null`) when absent.

method.description: HTTP method the request would have used.

name.description: App name a destructive verb targeted.

next_step.description:
What the caller should do next, when a recovery step exists.

`action` is closed: `register-app`, `sign-in`, `select-app`,
`inspect-store`, `enroll-app`, `show-help`. A step carries either a
`command`, runnable verbatim by a non-TTY caller, or a `template` whose
angle-bracket placeholders only the caller can fill, never both.

oauth2_username.description: The `OAuth2` user `auth clear` targeted; `null` when unset.

other_apps_with_creds.description: Other apps holding credentials, when the active one holds none.

post_id.description: Post id a destructive verb targeted.

reason.description:
Typed kebab-case kind; agents pattern-match on this.

The runtime emits: `auth-required`, `auth-method-mismatch`,
`client-credentials-missing`, `rate-limited`, `not-found`, `forbidden`,
`invalid-request`, `server-error`, `api-error`, `network-error`,
`invalid-args`, `unknown-command`, `invalid-method`,
`invalid-url`, `invalid-path-param`, `validation`, `serialization`,
`io`, `token-store`, `internal`, `confirmation-required`, `no-tty`,
`unsupported-pagination`, and the verb-local `invalid-json`,
`unknown-schema`, `validation-failed`, `missing-host`, `home-not-set`,
`destination-not-empty`, `destination-is-file`, `git-not-found`,
`git-clone-failed`, `not-installed`, and `remove-failed`.

rendered_url.description: Endpoint path with path parameters substituted.

requested.description: Auth scheme the caller asked for; `null` when auto-detect ran.

suggestion.description: The nearest real command, when one is within the threshold.

would_succeed.description: Whether a dry-run skill verb would have succeeded.
